OmaTasks no longer reads your clipboard behind your back. Every text field is now drawn by the plugin from key events, and the clipboard is read only when you paste.

![The token field, drawn from key events, with a masked token and a caret](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omatasks/v1.3.0/screenshots/token-field.png)

## Fixed

- **Other apps can no longer stall the shell through the clipboard.** Qt's editable text inputs read the clipboard whenever another application changes it, focused or not, and without a size limit or deadline. The task name, description, search, date, duration, panel size, token, and shortcut fields kept such inputs alive even while the panel was hidden. They are replaced by a field that never touches the clipboard on its own: **Ctrl+V** or **Shift+Insert** reads it through `wl-paste` in a separate process, stopped after two seconds and 4096 bytes, with control characters removed. By @crmne; thanks @HANCORE-linux for the report in [omacom/omarchy-plugin-marketplace#11212](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy-plugin-marketplace/issues/11212).
- **The fields keep their keys.** Typing, arrows (with **Ctrl** for words and **Shift** to select), **Home/End**, **Backspace** and **Delete** (with **Ctrl** for words), **Ctrl+A**, **Ctrl+U**, **Ctrl+Z**, copy and cut, Enter, Shift+Enter for a new line in the task name, Ctrl+Enter from Description, Quick Add autocomplete, highlights, and wrapping all work as before. The token field shows dots. By @crmne.

## New

- **A marketplace preview made of the real panels.** The Today panel and Quick Add, rendered with sample tasks, replace the old text card. By @crmne.

![Today panel and Quick Add](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omatasks/v1.3.0/preview.png)

## Known limitations

- Dead keys, compose sequences, and input methods (IME) do not work in the text fields. Keys that type a character directly, including accented letters on layouts that have them, work.
- Selecting text with the mouse is not supported. Click places the caret; use **Shift** with the arrow keys, Home, or End, or **Ctrl+A**.

## Validation

78 JavaScript tests, 23 composer UI checks, and 18 list interaction checks passed. QML parsing, shell syntax checks, and Omarchy plugin validation also passed. A test fails if any QML file uses a Qt text input or reads the clipboard outside an explicit paste, and an offscreen check confirms none is instantiated. Paste was tested against a stand-in `wl-paste` that sends too much and never finishes. Screenshots use synthetic tasks rendered from the real QML components on the NVIDIA GPU.

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omatasks.git --enable
```

Requires Omarchy Quattro and a Todoist account. Existing users can update the plugin through Omarchy.
